englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoF5.checkScreenTi: Check the exact screen title before switching perspective.
Default container titles matched in the current game language.
Additional exact titles; letter case must match.
Allow matching default or custom titles, or exclude those matches.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastPlace.cooldown.d: Ticks between item uses, sampled from this range after the item and start-delay checks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastPlace.applyTo.de: Apply when either hand contains a selected item class: projectile items or block items.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastPlace.startDelay: Wait this many milliseconds after the bound use mouse button was last pressed before changing cooldowns.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRespawn.delay.de: Ticks to wait after the death screen opens before respawning. Zero respawns immediately.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.keepSprint.motion.de: Percentage of horizontal motion retained after a sprint attack when HurtTime does not match.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.keepSprint.motionWhe: Percentage of horizontal motion retained after a sprint attack when HurtTime matches.
Remaining hurt-animation ticks that select MotionWhenHurt instead of Motion.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.keepSprint.chance.de: Chance to apply the configured motion multiplier. A failed roll uses the vanilla 60% multiplier.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoF5.checkScreenHa: Check the registered menu type before switching perspective.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoF5.checkScreenTi: Check the exact screen title before switching perspective.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.airJump.mode.descrip: Choose unrestricted air jumps, one extra jump before landing, or collision blocks below the player while the physical jump key is held.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noPush.pushBy.descri: Selected entities, blocks, fishing rods and liquids may push you. Sinking instead stops downward liquid motion while neither jump nor sneak is held.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reach.entity.rangeIn: Increase maximum entity attack and interaction range by this many blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reach.entity.through: Range for entities behind walls. When changed, this value is limited by the current entity interaction range.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reach.blockRangeIncr: Increase block interaction range by this many blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.reelDelay.d: Ticks to wait after a selected bite sound before reeling in. A random value is chosen from this range.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.sounds.desc: Registered sounds that signal a catch. The default is the fishing bobber splash.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.soundDistan: Check the distance from the active fishing hook to the bite sound to avoid unrelated sounds.
Maximum distance in blocks between your fishing hook and a selected sound.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.recastRod.e: Cast the rod again after reeling in a catch.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.recastRod.d: Random ticks to wait after reeling in before casting again.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.autoCastRod: Automatically cast while holding a fishing rod when no active fishing hook exists.
Random ticks to wait before automatically casting a rod without an active hook.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noPose.noSwim.descri: Prevent the local player from entering the swimming or crawling pose. The swimming movement state is unchanged.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noPose.sneakHeight.d: Use the crouching body height and eye height of Minecraft 1.8, 1.9 or 1.15. This also affects other player and mannequin avatars.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.recastRod.d: Cast the rod again after reeling in a catch.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoFish.autoCastRod: Automatically cast while holding a fishing rod when no active fishing hook exists.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noEntityInteract.ent: Allow interactions only with selected entity types, or block interactions with those types.
Registered entity types matched by EntityTypeFilter.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noEntityInteract.hol: Allow or block entity interactions according to the item held in the acting hand.
Items matched by HoldingItemFilter. Air represents an empty hand; item tags expand to their registered items.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.cameraClip.cameraDis: Set the target third-person camera distance. Animation uses this target when scroll adjustment is inactive.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.cameraClip.animation: Ease the camera distance each game tick; disabling this group keeps the vanilla distance while allowing wall clipping.
Animate third-person distance and reset its starting point when the perspective changes.
Set how far the distance moves toward its target each tick, after applying the easing function.
Choose the easing function applied to the distance animation speed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.cameraClip.scrollAdj: Adjust camera distance with the mouse wheel while its modifier and perspective requirements are met.
Enable wheel adjustment and suppress hotbar scrolling while adjustment is allowed.
Hold this key while scrolling to adjust distance; the unknown key requires no modifier.
Multiply the raw vertical wheel delta by this amount before adjusting distance.
Save the scrolled distance as CameraDistance when returning to first person, releasing the modifier, or enabling scroll adjustment.
Allow wheel adjustment only while FreeLook is running.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.dankBobbing.motion.d: Add this amount to the custom bobbing rotations while preserving the original walking translation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.twerk.delay.descript: Ticks spent sneaking and then not sneaking in each repeating cycle.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.multiActions.actions: Allow the selected combinations: placing while breaking, attacking while using an item, and breaking while using an item.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noRotateSet.mode.res: Settings used to smoothly return the managed rotation after a server correction in ResetRotation mode.
Choose how movement follows the managed rotation: Off, Strict, Silent, or ChangeLook.
Stop resetting once the managed rotation is within this many degrees of the visible rotation.
Keep the requested rotation for this many ticks before beginning the reset.
Random horizontal turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random vertical turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random horizontal turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Random vertical turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Steepness of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Midpoint of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Random limit on the change in horizontal turn speed each tick.
Random limit on the change in vertical turn speed each tick.
Use target-entity crosshair acceleration when a target exists. NoRotateSet reset requests have no target entity.
Distance contribution to acceleration. NoRotateSet reset requests use a target distance of zero.
Horizontal acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Vertical acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Add a random error proportional to the turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in horizontal turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in vertical turn acceleration.
Add a random fixed-angle error to each turn step.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in horizontal turns.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in vertical turns.
Scale turn acceleration by a Sigmoid curve as the remaining angle changes.
Steepness of the acceleration deceleration curve.
Midpoint of the acceleration deceleration curve.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitbox.size.descript: Replace eligible entities' picking radius with this size; component margin adds this amount.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitbox.applyToDebugH: Apply the same expansion to eligible F3+B hitboxes, including dragon parts using their parent's eligibility.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitbox.applyToCompon: Add Size to attack-range component margins for the local client player; this path does not filter targets.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.settings.targets.combat.des: Entity categories and states considered by combat modules. Self is unavailable; an empty selection is allowed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.settings.targets.visual.des: Entity categories and states considered by visual modules. Self requires third person, FreeCam or FreeLook.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWeapon.preferred: Preferred weapon categories; Any accepts all items. Multiple categories or an empty selection are allowed.
How eligible hotbar weapons are compared: default preference, knockback, damage or attack speed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWeapon.autoShiel: Prefer a shield-breaking weapon when the attacked target is blocking.
Prefer a mace when the fall and target conditions allow a smash attack.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWeapon.switchBac: Keep the silent weapon selection for this many ticks before returning to the original slot.
OnAttack runs when attacking. OnTarget accepts targeting requests from combat modules and does not select a crosshair target by itself.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.description: Choose a suitable tool while mining, using dynamic scoring or a fixed hotbar slot.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.toolSelecto: Allow nearly broken tools when choosing a mining tool.
Also consider suitable tools in the main inventory and move them through the inventory interaction constraints.
Random delay before beginning an inventory action, in milliseconds.
Random delay between inventory clicks, in milliseconds.
Random delay before closing an inventory action, in milliseconds.
Random percentage chance to miss an inventory click.
Scale inventory click delay according to the distance between slots.
Conditions that must hold before inventory actions, such as no movement, rotation, item use, mining or combat.
Use this fixed hotbar slot; values 0 through 8 correspond to slots 1 through 9.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.filter.desc: Choose whether the Blocks list allows or excludes automatic tool switching.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.blocks.desc: Blocks used by the tool-switching whitelist or blacklist.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.silkTouchHa: Apply the Silk Touch handling rules to the configured blocks.
Treat the Silk Touch block list as a whitelist or blacklist.
Blocks considered by the Silk Touch handling filter.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.swapBackDel: Ticks to keep the selected tool before returning to the previous slot.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.switchDelay: Wait this many ticks before switching to the chosen tool.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.notDuringCo: Pause automatic tool selection while in combat.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoTool.requireNear: Only select tools when a bed is within the configured distance.
Maximum distance to a bed for the nearby-bed condition.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.silentHotbar.noCoold: Keep the displayed attack cooldown from changing during silent hotbar selections.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.chams.mode.descripti: Choose Normal entity textures or use an image on parts hidden behind the scene.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.chams.mode.image.fil: Choose a PNG or JPG for occluded entity pixels. Failed loads keep the last successful image; without one, Normal is used.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.chams.mode.image.map: Repeat tiles the image, Stretch fills the screen, and Cover preserves aspect ratio while filling and centering.
Set each repeated tile width in screen pixels; its height preserves the image aspect ratio.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.chams.mode.image.fil: Nearest keeps sharp image pixels; Linear interpolates neighboring texels for smooth scaling.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.chams.mode.image.off: Add a screen-pixel offset to the image mapping; the image coordinate origin is at the lower left.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.swapBackDel: Game ticks before restoring the previous hotbar slot. The first SilentOffhand selection lasts at least five ticks; continued eating or drinking renews this delay.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.preferGappl: At or below this health, prefer regular golden apples. Lower active health thresholds rank first, followed by nutrition and slot proximity.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.preferNotch: At or below this health, prefer enchanted golden apples. Lower active health thresholds rank first, followed by nutrition and slot proximity.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.preferHealt: At or below this health, consider drinkable potions containing Instant Health. Splash potions are excluded from this preference.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.combatPause: Pause combat for at least this many game ticks when selecting food, eating, or forcing the use key.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.notDuringCo: Prevent SilentOffhand actions and new AutoEat sequences during combat. An AutoEat sequence already running checks its normal completion condition.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.silentOffha: Select food silently when a right-click with a mining tool would otherwise pass. The normal item-use path consumes the selected food.
When a mining tool is held and right-click otherwise passes, silently select eligible food from the offhand or hotbar. This selection does not move items into the offhand.
Preview the best food in an extra HUD slot left of the hotbar.
Draw the best current food in a separate offhand-style HUD slot. It is a preview of the selected candidate.
Horizontal distance added to the left of the hotbar for the food preview. Larger values move it farther left.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.autoEat.des: Automatically select and use food when hunger falls below the configured threshold, until it rises above that threshold.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.autoEat.ena: Start eating when hunger falls below MinHunger. Select eligible food and hold the use key until hunger rises above MinHunger.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.smartEat.autoEat.min: Hunger threshold for AutoEat: strictly below starts a sequence; strictly above finishes it. Equality alone neither starts nor finishes a sequence.
Configure smoothing, movement correction and return rules for custom anti-AFK rotation requests.
Choose how movement follows the managed rotation: Off, Strict, Silent, or ChangeLook.
Stop resetting once the managed rotation is within this many degrees of the visible rotation.
Keep the requested rotation for this many ticks before beginning the reset.
Random horizontal turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random vertical turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random horizontal turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Random vertical turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Steepness of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Midpoint of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Random limit on the change in horizontal turn speed each tick.
Random limit on the change in vertical turn speed each tick.
Use target-entity crosshair acceleration when a target exists. Anti-AFK requests have no target entity.
Distance contribution to acceleration. Anti-AFK requests use a target distance of zero.
Horizontal acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; anti-AFK requests without an entity do not use it.
Vertical acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; anti-AFK requests without an entity do not use it.
Add a random error proportional to the turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in horizontal turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in vertical turn acceleration.
Add a random fixed-angle error to each turn step.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in horizontal turns.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in vertical turns.
Scale turn acceleration by a Sigmoid curve as the remaining angle changes.
Steepness of the acceleration deceleration curve.
Midpoint of the acceleration deceleration curve.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiAFK.mode.descrip: Choose Old forward movement and turning, random interactions, or custom anti-AFK actions.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiAFK.mode.randomI: Allow randomly chosen actions: jumping, swinging, changing slots, yaw, pitch or random movement.
Game-tick range to wait after each random action; random movement also lasts a duration from this range.
Submit anti-AFK rotation requests at the configured interval.
Allow anti-AFK rotation requests while the inventory is open.
Wait this many game ticks before each custom rotation request.
Add this angle to the current server yaw; pitch separately receives a random offset from -5 to 5 degrees.
Swing the main hand at the configured interval.
When no swing is active, wait this many game ticks before starting another swing.
Automatically jump while on the ground.
Continuously hold the forward key.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.derp.yaw.offset.offs: Add this angle to the player's visible horizontal rotation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.derp.yaw.jitter.forw: Follow the player's horizontal rotation for this many game ticks in each jitter cycle.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.derp.yaw.jitter.back: Face 180 degrees behind the player's horizontal rotation for this many game ticks in each jitter cycle.
Add this many degrees to the accumulated horizontal rotation each game tick; a negative value reverses the spin.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.derp.pitch.static.pi: Use this fixed vertical rotation; SafePitch limits the result to -90 through 90 degrees.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.derp.pitch.offset.of: Add this angle to the player's visible vertical rotation before applying SafePitch.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.derp.safePitch.descr: Limit the requested vertical rotation to -90 through 90 degrees; Random also chooses within that range.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.derp.notDuringSprint: Skip Derp rotation requests while the sprint key is held or the player is sprinting.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.tridentBoost.horizon: Multiply the horizontal components of the trident's Riptide dash by this factor.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.tridentBoost.vertica: Multiply the vertical component of the trident's Riptide dash by this factor.
Allow Riptide use without being in water or rain.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeLook.perspective: View the player from the front or back while moving the camera independently of the player's facing direction.
Multiply FreeLook mouse rotation by this factor after the game's mouse sensitivity, inversion and zoom scaling.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeLook.noPitchLimi: Allow the camera to rotate vertically beyond -90 through 90 degrees; disabling this limits its pitch on the next mouse input.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.handDerp.silent.desc: Cancel an entire received entity-data packet when it contains an index equal to the actual main-hand option ID (0 or 1), matching the original module.
Wait this many game ticks between sending alternating main-hand preferences to the server; the local main-hand option stays unchanged.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockBounce.motion.d: Add this amount to normal jump power when jumping on a slime block, honey block or bed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vehicleBoost.horizon: When leaving a vehicle, replace horizontal velocity with this speed in the direction the player is facing.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vehicleBoost.vertica: When leaving a vehicle, replace vertical velocity with this upward speed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.entityControl.enforc: Saddled forces the mob saddle check to succeed; JumpStrength makes the local player report full mount jump charge. Each can be selected independently.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.skinDerp.sync.descri: Flip each selected skin part from its current state when enabled; otherwise randomly choose each selected part's visibility independently.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.skinDerp.delay.descr: Wait this many game ticks before each skin-part update. Zero updates on each eligible tick without waiting.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.skinDerp.parts.descr: Choose the hat, jacket, left and right pants, left and right sleeves, and cape to change. Disabling restores the skin-part selection saved when enabled.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockWalk.blocks.des: Treat selected blocks as full cubes during collision scans. The defaults are cobweb and snow; visual and directly queried block shapes retain their normal geometry.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vomit.constraints.de: Timing and requirements for the module's inventory action plans.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vomit.constraints.st: Random delay in milliseconds when opening the inventory or starting after a recent open. Cursor travel can add a distance-based delay.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vomit.constraints.cl: Random delay in milliseconds between inventory actions. In creative mode, a maximum of zero enables filling and throwing all available empty storage slots in one plan.
Random delay in milliseconds before closing the inventory or a container screen when the action plan needs to close it.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vomit.constraints.mi: Random chance to simulate a miss on the first ordinary click of a chain. Throw actions do not simulate misses.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vomit.constraints.sl: Extra cursor-travel delay per slot of distance, multiplied by a random base delay. Start travel begins at the screen center; later travel begins at the previous slot.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vomit.constraints.re: Require selected conditions before actions: no movement or jumping, no rotation change, no item use, no mining, no combat, or an open player inventory when the action needs it. All selected conditions must pass.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.vomit.constraints.mi: Saved compatibility marker for millisecond delays. Legacy files lacking both this marker and an Interop value type convert delay endpoints from ticks by multiplying by 50.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.ghostHand.targetedBl: Prioritize ray hits on selected blocks through other blocks. If no selected block is hit, use the ordinary block and fluid raycast. Defaults include chests and all shulker boxes.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strafe.strengthInAir: Blend horizontal self-movement toward the untransformed input direction while airborne. One fully redirects it at the same horizontal speed; zero leaves movement unchanged.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strafe.strengthOnGro: Blend horizontal self-movement toward the untransformed input direction while on the ground. One fully redirects it at the same horizontal speed; zero leaves movement unchanged.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strafe.strictMovemen: Set horizontal self-movement to zero when the player move vector is zero. The selected ground or air strength must be nonzero; vertical movement is preserved.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.extendedFirework.mod: Three boost-formula coefficients, not separate world axes: x is added look-direction acceleration, y is target look-direction speed, and z is the correction fraction toward that target. Defaults are 0.1, 1.65 and 0.5; the formula applies to every velocity axis.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastBreak.breakDamag: Each game tick, clear the block-breaking delay and complete progress only when it is strictly greater than this threshold. Default 0.8; the original slider range is 0.1–1.0. Disabling restores the normal delay of 5 ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastBreak.onlyTool.d: Apply the tick changes and the Grim mode packet only while the actual main hand belongs to the axe, pickaxe, shovel or hoe item tags. Shears and swords do not qualify.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastBreak.mode.descr: None keeps only the tick changes. Grim-2.3.48 additionally sends an ordinary ABORT_DESTROY_BLOCK packet for the block above each outgoing STOP_DESTROY_BLOCK, preserving its face and using sequence 0. AbortAnother is the original mode alias.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.settings.inventory.response: Allow this many milliseconds for the server to open a container, restore a clicked item, or undo that restore. Inventory clicks wait while a reply may still change their result. Default 400 ms; the original slider range is 50–2000 ms.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.settings.inventory.lockAfte: After the server restores the same clicked item this many times, leave it alone until the world changes. Default 3; the original slider range is 1–10.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.descripti: Classic uses a constant speed; Pulse alternates normal and boosted segments; Boost manages speed against the shared timer balance.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.classic.s: Request this game speed every game tick. Default 2; the original slider range is 0.1–20.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.pulse.nor: Speed during the normal segment. Default 0.5; slider 0.1–20.
Game ticks in each normal segment. Default 20; slider 1–500.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.pulse.boo: Speed during the boosted segment. Default 2; slider 0.1–20.
Game ticks in each boosted segment. Default 20; slider 1–500.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.pulse.onM: Start a new segment only while the player is moving. A segment already requested keeps its lifetime when movement stops.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.boost.boo: Speed requested while moving when balance is above its lower bound. Default 1.3; slider 0.1–20.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.boost.slo: Speed requested while stationary to rebuild balance, except in inventory and container screens. Default 0.6; slider 0.1–20.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.boost.nor: Request normal speed while the shared combat manager reports combat. Enabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.boost.bal: Clamp shared balance to this range before spending or saving it. The lower bound limits running ahead; the upper bound limits saved ticks. Default 0–20 ticks; slider -100–200.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.timer.mode.boost.res: While Boost is running, clear the balance on the render executor after receiving a player position correction, including a packet cancelled by another listener.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.terrainSpeed.fastCli: Enable the selected fast climbing behavior.
Choose the original fast climbing mode.
Vertical motion used by Motion climbing mode.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.terrainSpeed.iceSpee: Slipperiness returned for the ice blocks handled by this module.
Enable the additional ice motion behavior.
Motion value used by the additional ice movement behavior.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.terrainSpeed.waterSp: Apply the original automatic swimming behavior in water.
Horizontal speed for the base water movement behavior.
Vertical speed for the base water movement behavior.
Use the configured water sprint speeds when sprinting.
Horizontal speed while sprinting in water.
Vertical speed while sprinting in water.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.highJump.mode.descri: Vanilla replaces jump motion. Vulcan-2.7.5 also clears vertical velocity after 100 game ticks and can enable gliding.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.highJump.motion.desc: Vertical motion applied at the start of each jump. Default 0.8; the original slider range is 0.2–10.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.highJump.mode.vulcan: Apply the original gliding motion after the 100-tick delay, until landing. Disabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.itemScroller.clickMo: QuickMove transfers the hovered item while physical Shift and the left mouse button are held.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.itemScroller.delay.d: Random delay sampled for each eligible transfer check. Default 2–3 ticks; the original slider range is 0–20.
Prevents sprinting through movement input and outgoing sprint state. Swimming is excluded unless WhileSwimming is enabled.
Prevent sprinting through movement input and outgoing sprint state. Enabled by default.
Also prevent sprinting while swimming. Disabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiHunger.keepFloat: Send movement as airborne while not falling. Vehicles, block breaking and contact with water are excluded. Enabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.elytraSwap.constrain: Timing and requirements for the module's inventory action plans.
Random delay in milliseconds when opening the inventory or starting after a recent open. Cursor travel can add a distance-based delay.
Random delay in milliseconds between pickup actions. The module disables after the complete swap chain finishes.
Random delay in milliseconds before closing the inventory or a container screen when the action plan needs to close it.
Chance to simulate a miss on the first normal click in an action chain. The remaining pickup actions execute in order.
Extra cursor-travel delay per slot of distance, multiplied by a random base delay. Start travel begins at the screen center; later travel begins at the previous slot.

Require selected conditions before actions: no movement or jumping, no rotation change, no item use, no mining, no combat, or an open player inventory when the action needs it. All selected conditions must pass.
Saved compatibility marker for millisecond delays. Legacy files lacking both this marker and an Interop value type convert delay endpoints from ticks by multiplying by 50.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.guiCloser.descriptio: Closes GUIs if their title matches specified patterns.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.guiCloser.mode.descr: Matches tests the entire container title; Contains searches for any matching part. Both modes use Java regular expressions.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.guiCloser.filter.des: Ordered Java regular expressions for container titles. The first matching expression prevents that screen from opening. The default is ^Vote$.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.guiCloser.printScree: Print unmatched container titles in chat. Click the highlighted title to copy it. This setting is saved locally and shown in the interface, but omitted from public configuration exports.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.textFieldProtect.des: Hides rendered text of text field widget when it matches certain patterns.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.textFieldProtect.pat: Java regular expressions matched against each visible substring before text formatting. Defaults: ^/register.*, ^/login.*, ^/email.*. A match renders asterisks using the original module's display-position count. Input, clipboard and submitted text stay intact.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.resetVL.description: Resets anticheat violations on flawed anti-cheats.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.resetVL.times.descri: Number of grounded upward/downward sequences before the module disables itself and reports success. Each sequence sets all velocity axes to (0, 0.1, 0), waits one game tick, then sets (0, -0.1, 0). Partial progress survives disable and re-enable.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.resetVL.timer.descri: Client timer speed requested at the user safety priority during each started tick handler, including while airborne. Higher-priority requests take precedence. The module applies no server packet or movement-mode replacement.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.nameCollector.descri: Collects the names of all players on the server.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoLeave.descriptio: Automatically leaves the server whenever your health goes below the certain threshold.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.kick.mode.descriptio: Method used to leave a multiplayer server: disconnect, invalid position, self attack, invalid chat, invalid selected slot, or self interaction.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoLeave.health.des: Leave when health is below this value. Creative mode, a single-player server, and a death-protection component in either hand interrupt the waiting condition.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoLeave.delay.desc: Random number of game ticks to wait. A zero delay checks the condition immediately. Positive delays check the condition on each following tick.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoLeave.mode.descr: Select one of the same six disconnect methods as Kick.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.targetLock.descripti: Makes you attack only one specific enemy.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.targetLock.mode.desc: Temporary locks players on attack until they leave range or time expires. Filter selects profile usernames. Temporary locks survive toggles and mode changes.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.targetLock.combat.de: Restrict only combat targeting: other players become Interesting. When disabled, other players become Ignored for all targeting consumers.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.targetLock.mode.temp: Seconds before an attack lock expires. Repeated attacks refresh the deadline. Default 30; UI range 0–120 seconds.
Remove locks when a player is at or beyond this Euclidean distance. Range is checked before expiry. Default 20; UI range 8–40 blocks.
AllowAll permits all players while no lock exists; AllowNone excludes every player until an attack creates a lock.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.targetLock.mode.filt: Profile usernames matched with Java case-insensitive comparison. Entries preserve order and duplicates; null entries match no player.
Whitelist permits listed usernames. Blacklist permits every username absent from the list.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.yggdrasilSignatureFi: Disables Authlib Yggdrasil signature check, may fix missing skins on some servers.
For skin texture URLs containing 127.0.0.1, force the slim arm model. Other texture URLs retain their original model. Signature and texture-domain bypasses remain active independently of this option.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.damage.description: Deals the specified amount of damage to yourself.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.plugins.description: Attempts to list all plugins installed on the server.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.damage.mode.descript: Select the NCP, AAC or Verus self-damage method.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.damage.damage.descri: Requested damage in health points. NCP scales the movement packet repetitions and AAC scales upward velocity; Verus uses its fixed movement sequence.
Configured module names. The original keeps this setting separate from active membership; use .autodisable add, remove, clear or list to manage the active selection.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoDisable.on.descr: Disable selected modules after a server position correction, local player death, world replacement or disconnect. At least one trigger remains selected.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.plugins.try.descript: Try /plugins, /bukkit:plugins, and command suggestions in the selected order. The module turns off when detection completes.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.trueSight.sight.desc: Objects to reveal: invisible living entities, barriers and light blocks. Markers use the normal random animate-tick sampling.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.trueSight.entityColo: ARGB tint of invisible living entity bodies. Default white, alpha 100.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.trueSight.entityFeat: ARGB tint of colored cutout feature models. Equipment and held items keep their own render colors. Default white, alpha 120.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noClip.speed.descrip: Horizontal and vertical flight speed. Jump takes priority over sneak. Default 0.32; UI range 0.1–0.4.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noClip.onlyInVehicle: Pause NoClip while you do not control a vehicle. Pausing restores collision without disabling the module.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noClip.disableOnSetb: Show the original setback error and disable NoClip when a player-position correction arrives while active.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.potionSpoof.level.de: Spoofed potion level. Default 1; UI range 1–10. Imported levels retain their raw value; the effect amplifier is clamped to 0–255 by Minecraft.
Add this zero-duration effect and its attribute modifiers each player tick. Turning it off removes only a zero-duration effect.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.trueSight.descriptio: Allows you to see invisible objects and entities.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.potionSpoof.descript: Allows the player to have potion effects without actually having the potion.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.noClip.description: Allows you to move through blocks (let a sand block drop on your head first).

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.oldRegen.health.desc: Send extra movement packets to accelerate legacy server regeneration.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.oldRegen.health.heal: Target health in health points. Default 16; UI range 0–20.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.oldRegen.health.incr: Packets per missing health point. Default 20; UI range 0–60.
Accelerate the longest finite harmful effect using extra movement packets.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.oldRegen.fire.descri: Send at least nine packets while burning outside water and rain.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.oldRegen.maximumSpee: Cap only the harmful effect contribution. Health based packets retain the original independent count.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.oldRegen.timer.descr: Request the shared client timer while sending packets. Default 1.0; UI range 0.1–10.
Skip regeneration in selected situations: airborne, moving, regeneration effect active, or food below 20.
Choose status, position, rotation, or full movement packets.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.oldRegen.description: Abuses Minecraft 1.8 mechanics to allow faster regeneration and removes negative status effects like fire and poison.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spider.description: Allows you to climb walls like spiderman.
Vertical velocity while touching a wall in Vanilla mode.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spider.mode.polar-20: Jump motion while touching a wall in Polar mode. Values above 0.42 replace the original jump motion.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.descript: Automatically authenticates you on cracked servers.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.password: Password used for login and registration. Stored with private client settings.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.delay.de: Random delay in game ticks after a connection is available.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.register: Registration command without its leading slash.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.loginCom: Login command without its leading slash.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.register: Java regular expression matching registration prompts. Checked before the login expression.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.loginReg: Java regular expression matching login prompts.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.repeatPa: Include the password twice in registration commands.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoAccount.messageS: Watch chat, title and subtitle messages for account prompts.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.middleClickAction.de: Allows you to perform actions with middle clicks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.middleClickAction.mo: Maximum player ray distance for adding or removing friends.
Ticks before the pearl hotbar selection resets.
Suppress pearl use while player pitch lies in this inclusive range.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.mobOwners.projectile: Also show the owner of projectiles. Disabled by default. Online owners use their live profile name; other UUIDs use a persistent asynchronous Minecraft Services profile lookup.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.combineMobs.combineA: Also combine armor stands of the same size and block position. Disabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.combineMobs.combineM: Also combine minecarts with the same actual entity type and block position. Disabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.sorting.de: Stable player-list order: vanilla, signed ping, UTF-16 name/display-name length, UTF-16 alphabetical/reversed, or unchanged input order.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.visibility: Show the header, footer, or raw profile names only. NameOnly also removes the game-mode suffix.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.showGameMo: Append [S], [C], or [A] to normal display names. Spectator uses [S], exactly as the source.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.limits.tab: Maximum displayed players. Default 80; UI range 1–1000.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.limits.col: Maximum rows per column. Default 20; UI range 1–100. Imported values use a minimum effective height of 1.
Replace row backgrounds in priority order: self, friends, then matching other players.
Highlight your exact, case-sensitive profile name.
Highlight names in the actual case-sensitive friend list.
Highlight other players only when their configured filter matches. An empty regex list matches nobody.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.accurateLa: Show numeric ping, clamped to 0–9999 ms. Green below 150, yellow below 300, otherwise red.
Append ms to the numeric latency.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.playerHide: Hide matching players before sorting and limiting the list.
Row background ARGB color, including alpha.
Row background ARGB color, including alpha.
Row background ARGB color, including alpha.
Test the optional display name, the raw profile name, or both.
Java regular expressions matched against the whole selected name. Empty list matches nobody.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.playerHide: Test the optional display name, the raw profile name, or both.
Java regular expressions matched against the whole selected name. Empty list matches nobody.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.mobOwners.descriptio: Allows you to see which player a tamed entity or projectile belongs to.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.betterTab.descriptio: Multiple improvements to the tab list.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.superKnockback.descr: Increases knockback dealt to other entities.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.superKnockback.hurtT: Maximum target hurt time at which knockback modification may run.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.superKnockback.chanc: Chance of modifying knockback for each eligible attack.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.superKnockback.condi: Require the target to face you, your player to stand on ground, or your player to stay outside water and bubble columns.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.superKnockback.onlyO: Apply knockback modification only while your player has movement input.
Require movement input before modifying knockback.
Reject sideways input. Forward and backward input both remain eligible.
Ticks to wait after both actual sprinting and the last sent sprint state stop, before allowing sprint again.
Ticks to wait after an eligible attack before blocking directional movement.
Ticks to wait after forward impulse stops before allowing directional movement again.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastUse.description: Allows you to use items faster.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastUse.conditions.d: Accelerate only while the selected restrictions are satisfied.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastUse.stopInput.de: Stop directional movement while the use key is held.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastUse.packetType.d: Movement packet format used to accelerate item use.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastUse.mode.immedia: Wait this many ticks before sending packets; cancel if use conditions cease.
Temporary timer speed while waiting to accelerate use.
Movement packets sent before releasing the used item.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastUse.mode.itemUse: Minimum item use time in ticks before acceleration.
Movement packets sent after the minimum use time.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fastUse.mode.crossbo: Perform the hand swap and crossbow use sequence on this tick interval.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockOutline.sideOnl: Highlight the connected region of the hit face. A single box uses only its selected side.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockOutline.color.d: Face fill ARGB color, including alpha.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockOutline.slide.e: Animate transitions between single-box targets. Complex shapes reset the transition and render their actual exposed surface.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockOutline.slide.t: Slide duration in milliseconds. Default 150; UI range 1–1000.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockOutline.slide.e: The source easing curve used for the slide transition.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.blockOutline.descrip: Changes the way Minecraft highlights blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.mode.descri: Forward holds forward; Direction navigates where the camera faces; Goto walks to a destination; Follow tracks a named player.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.mode.goto.d: Block coordinates to reach. Picking ground moves the feet to the standable block above it.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.mode.follow: Exact profile name of the player to follow.
Stop within this many blocks of the player. Default 3; range 1–10.
Allow breaking blocks along the route.
Allow placing suitable hotbar blocks along the route.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.allowParkou: Search and follow jump routes across gaps.
Allow jumps with less landing margin.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.maxFall.des: Largest permitted dry fall, additionally limited by player health.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.pathRange.d: Maximum distance considered in each route search. Default 64 blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.allowFly.de: Use creative flight when player abilities permit it.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.allowElytra: Use an equipped elytra to glide along the route.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.elytraRocke: Use available fireworks to propel elytra flight.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.allowBoat.d: Use a boat when travelling across water.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.allowEat.de: Eat available food along the route when hungry.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.enab: Show the searched route, progress and destination.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.canB: Let world geometry hide route graphics.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.sear: Color of the route search preview.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.brea: Color of blocks scheduled to be broken.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.plac: Color of blocks scheduled to be placed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.targ: Color of route targets and engaged ghost graphics.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.inva: Color of a route invalidated by the world or server.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.ghos: Show a server position ghost when the navigation view supplies one.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.render.fade: Milliseconds before completed or invalid routes disappear. Default 800.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.rotations.d: Settings used to smoothly return the managed rotation after a server correction in ResetRotation mode.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.rotations.m: Choose how movement follows the managed rotation: Off, Strict, Silent, or ChangeLook.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.rotations.r: Stop resetting once the managed rotation is within this many degrees of the visible rotation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoWalk.rotations.t: Keep the requested rotation for this many ticks before beginning the reset.

Maximum fall height to imitate. The highest offset with no block collision is used; intermediate heights are skipped.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.teams.description: Prevents KillAura from attacking team mates.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.teams.matches.descri: Identify teammates by scoreboard alliance, the first visible name color, or a shared name prefix.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.teams.armorColor.des: Also identify players with the same dyed color in any selected armor slot. Undyed items never match each other.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.teams.colorSources.d: Resolve tag color from the first available source, respecting the stored source order.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.parkour.assist.enabl: Plan gap crossings, time take-off, steer in air and settle on narrow landings.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.parkour.assist.maxAn: Search for landings within this angle of movement heading. Default 35 degrees.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.parkour.assist.rende: Preview the jump trajectory, take-off, landing and aim point.
Allow blocks to occlude the jump preview.

Color of the take-off line and run-up marker.
Color of the landing block and touchdown footprint.
Color of the aiming post and cross at eye height.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.safeWalk.mode.onEdge: Random edge check distance, capped at current horizontal speed. Default 0.1–0.15 blocks.

Stop clears movement at low speed; Invert reverses keys; Center moves toward the last safe block center. High speed also uses Center.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spammer.mps.descript: Random number of messages sent in each batch.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spammer.messages.too: Spammer message is too long! (Max 256 characters)

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.pingSpoof.delay.desc: Delay incoming KeepAlive and Ping packets by this many milliseconds. Disabling flushes the queue; disconnecting discards packets belonging to the old connection.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.anchor.description: Pulls you into safe holes for crystal PvP.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.anchor.maxDistance.d: Maximum distance to a safe hole, from 0.1 to 6 blocks. Default 4.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.anchor.horizontalSpe: Maximum horizontal movement applied toward the hole. Default 0.3.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.anchor.verticalSpeed: Maximum downward movement applied toward the hole. Default 0.1.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.avoidHazards.descrip: Prevents you from walking into blocks that might affect you negatively.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.avoidHazards.mode.de: Shape adds collision to selected hazards. Input predicts movement and redirects movement keys.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.avoidHazards.avoid.d: Hazards to avoid. All ten types are enabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeze.description: Allows you to freeze yourself in your current position without the server knowing.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.descript: Queue buffers packets, Cancel drops packets, Stationary sends interaction rotations, and TickMovement releases movement at intervals.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.queue.or: Packet directions to buffer until Freeze is disabled. Outgoing by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.cancel.o: Packet directions to drop while frozen. Outgoing by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.stationa: Cancel the pong reply while frozen. Enabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeze.mode.tickMove: Ticks between released movement updates. Default 20 ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.freeze.disableOn.des: Disable Freeze when selected conditions occur. Server correction is selected by default.
Show a notification when Freeze is disabled by a selected condition.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spearKill.descriptio: Automatically attacks enemies using a charged spear.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spearKill.maxTargetD: Maximum distance to find a living target along the view direction.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spearKill.maxSpeed.d: Maximum movement speed per tick during the charge attack and return.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spearKill.preview.de: Show the current target bounding box.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spearKill.preview.fi: Fill color and transparency of the target preview.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.spearKill.preview.ou: Outline color and transparency of the target preview.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.clip.choice.fancy.ho: Maximum horizontal search distance; a blocked position must occur before a reachable opening.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.clip.choice.fancy.ve: Maximum upward and downward search distance.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.clip.choice.fancy.al: Allow destinations in the selected fluids when the space above is air or the same fluid.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.clip.choice.fancy.re: Require center support below the destination, except when clipping upward.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.clip.choice.old.hori: Horizontal offset along the facing direction when enabled.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.clip.choice.old.vert: Vertical offset when enabled; negative values move downward.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.clip.choice.old.rese: Clear movement velocity after the one-time offset.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.descript: Allows you to step down blocks faster.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.mode.des: Instant predicts the landing, Strict sets downward velocity, and Accelerator multiplies existing downward velocity.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.maximumF: Maximum fall distance. ReverseStep requires block collision at that distance and avoids deliberate jumps. Default 1 block.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.mode.ins: Maximum prediction ticks to find a landing. Default 20.
Send the successful predicted falling path as movement packets before moving to the landing.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.reverseStep.mode.acc: Multiply downward velocity by this factor and clear horizontal velocity. Default 1.

Random delay in milliseconds between pickup actions. The module disables after the complete swap chain finishes.

Chance to simulate a miss on the first normal click in an action chain. The remaining pickup actions execute in order.

Require selected conditions before actions: no movement or jumping, no rotation change, no item use, no mining, no combat, or an open player inventory when the action needs it. All selected conditions must pass.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.bookBot.mode.file.cy: Read the text file again from the beginning after reaching its end.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.bookBot.mode.file.so: Text file used to fill books.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.bookBot.sign.descrip: Sign the book after filling its pages.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.bookBot.sign.name.de: Book title; %count% is replaced by the number of books generated since enabling.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.tracers.description: Draw lines from the camera eye vector to visible living entities.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.tracers.colorMode.de: Friend blue takes priority, followed by entity tags, then the selected color mode.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.tracers.colorMode.st: Static ARGB color, default opaque blue-cyan.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.tracers.maximumDista: Camera distance to current entity position; default 128 blocks, UI range 1–512.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.description: Allows you to step up blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.descriptio: Choose Instant, vanilla auto jump, Vulcan, BlocksMC or Hypixel stepping.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.instant.tr: Cap simulated jump packet heights at the actual step destination.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.instant.si: Inclusive jump trajectory indices to send. 0..0 sends no packets; default 0..2.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.instant.wa: Random cooldown between height overrides, in game ticks. Default 0..0.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.instant.pa: Use full movement or position and ground packets for the simulated jump.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.blocksMC.b: Timer speed requested during the first three stepping ticks. Default 3.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.blocksMC.r: Timer speed requested for two ticks after stepping. Default 0.6.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.step.mode.hypixel-20: After a 1.5 block step, set the body on ground instead of repeating upward velocity.
Report on ground on the eighth airborne movement tick.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.sneak.mode.legit.onM: Sneak only when a two-tick prediction touches magma and the player is not immune to its damage.
Do not force sneaking while movement input is nonzero.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.liquidWalk.descripti: Allows you to walk on water and lava.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.liquidWalk.mode.desc: Vanilla adds surface collision and swim input. NCP and Verus adjust movement packets; Vulcan boosts upward in water or bubble columns.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.liquidWalk.mode.vulc: Upward velocity in water or bubble columns. Default 0.8; this mode does not boost in lava.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.triggerBot.descripti: Attacks the crosshair target when it passes the combat target filters.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoClicker.descript: Plans repeated attack and use clicks while their physical key is held.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.ro: Aim using the full combat rotation processor chain.
Choose how movement follows the managed rotation: Off, Strict, Silent, or ChangeLook.
Stop resetting once the managed rotation is within this many degrees of the visible rotation.
Keep the requested rotation for this many ticks before beginning the reset.
Random horizontal turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random vertical turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random horizontal turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Random vertical turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Steepness of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Midpoint of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Random limit on the change in horizontal turn speed each tick.
Random limit on the change in vertical turn speed each tick.
Use target-entity crosshair acceleration when a target exists. NoRotateSet reset requests have no target entity.
Distance contribution to acceleration. NoRotateSet reset requests use a target distance of zero.
Horizontal acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Vertical acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Add a random error proportional to the turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in horizontal turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in vertical turn acceleration.
Add a random fixed-angle error to each turn step.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in horizontal turns.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in vertical turns.
Scale turn acceleration by a Sigmoid curve as the remaining angle changes.
Steepness of the acceleration deceleration curve.
Midpoint of the acceleration deceleration curve.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.de: Punch incoming large fireballs, shulker bullets and selected wind charges.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.cl: Independent attack click plan shared with other attack clickers and physical presses.
Human varies the click rhythm; Constant uses the upper CPS endpoint. Default Human.
Clicks per second, sampled by the selected technique. Default 11–14.
Limit scheduled clicks in one game tick. Default 2.
Wait for the real miss timer before attacking. Default true; this clicker has no item-cooldown setting.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.ra: Maximum attack and one-tick prediction range. Default 3 blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.sw: Control local and server swings. Default DoNotHide.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.ig: Permit requested rotations while the inventory is open. Default true.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.pr: Select Fireball, ShulkerBullet and WindCharge. Default Fireball and ShulkerBullet.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.on: Acquire targets only while the player is not on the ground. Default false.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.fO: Maximum angle between the local view and the projectile physical box. Default 180 degrees.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.projectilePuncher.ro: Choose Linear, Sigmoid, Interpolation, Acceleration or AI. Default Linear.
Temporarily limit rotation to a tiny movement.
Enable short stops. Default false.
Chance of starting a stop during each processed rotation. Default 3 percent.
Number of processed rotations to stop. Default 1–2 ticks.
Occasionally offset aim using previous and server rotations.
Enable deliberate aim failures. Default false.
Chance per game tick of starting a failure. Default 3 percent.
Scale the previous-to-server rotation difference. Default 0.04.
Random horizontal aim shift. Default 5–10 degrees.
Random vertical aim shift. Default 0–2 degrees.
Keep the sampled failure for this many ticks. Default 1–4.
Use the selected model when the learning engine is available; this native runtime uses the original Interpolation fallback.
Select the original built-in regression model. Default 21KC11KP.
Correction after model output: Interpolation, Linear or None. Retained while AI falls back.
Horizontal model-correction speed. Default 5 degrees.
Vertical model-correction speed. Default 5 degrees.
Scale the two model outputs before correction.
Model horizontal-output multiplier. Default 1.5.
Model vertical-output multiplier. Default 1.
Interpolate toward the target using angle and direction change.
Horizontal interpolation speed. Default 80–85 percent.
Vertical interpolation speed. Default 20–25 percent.
Additional factor for changing target direction. Default 95–100 percent.
Threshold between sigmoid and Bezier interpolation. Default 0.35.
Interpolate toward the target using angle and direction change.
Horizontal interpolation speed. Default 2–5 percent.
Vertical interpolation speed. Default 2–5 percent.
Additional factor for changing target direction. Default 95–100 percent.
Threshold between sigmoid and Bezier interpolation. Default 0.35.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.xRay.fullBright.desc: Disable terrain ambient occlusion and light the world while XRay is active.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.xRay.exposedOnly.des: Only show listed blocks beside a block that does not conduct redstone.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.xRay.backgroundOpaci: Opacity of other non-air blocks, from 0 (hidden) to 255 (opaque).
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.xRay.blocks.descript: Blocks to reveal. Changes rebuild loaded terrain. Manage the list with the xray command.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiBot.description: Identify player bots using the original four modes and ignore them in target tagging. Disabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiBot.mode.descrip: Select Custom, Matrix-2021-10-18, Intave-2022-07-28 or Horizon-2021-10-18. Default Custom.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiBot.literalNPC.d: Treat players missing from the online-player UUID collection as bots. Default false.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiBot.notInTabList: Check the server-listed player collection after a spawn grace period.
Treat unlisted players as bots after Grace ticks. Default false.
Allow this many entity ticks before checking the listed player collection. Default 0; range 0–200.
Combine the chosen checks and history-based groups; any enabled check can identify a bot.
Select checks. Default NoGameMode, IllegalPitch and FakeEntityID.
Track inconsistent ground and movement state observed before vanilla packet handling.
Accumulate violations while grounded with a changed Y position; airborne packets halve them. Default true.
Violation count required to identify a bot. Default 10; range 1–50 flags.
Remember whether each player has ever left the configured radius.
Treat players that have never left the radius as bots. Default false.
Distance from the local player used for the persistent radius history. Default 20; range 5–30 blocks.
Check the player entity tick count.
Treat entities younger than Minimum as bots. Default false.
Minimum entity age. Default 20; range 0–120 ticks.
Remember whether the player position has changed.
After Minimum ticks, treat players without movement history as bots. Default false.
Wait before requiring recorded movement. Default 160; range 20–400 ticks.
Inspect only the first metadata packet for each entity.
Treat a first metadata packet no larger than Maximum as a bot signal. Default false.
Maximum first-packet metadata entries considered minimal. Default 3; range 0–10 entries.
Remember players whose equipment fails the selected per-slot rules, clearing them once valid.
Enable equipment-rule history. Default false.
Accepted head equipment; empty selection skips the slot. Default Nothing. Includes turtle helmet, carved pumpkin and skulls.
Accepted chest equipment; empty selection skips the slot. Default Nothing. Elytra matches the glider component.
Accepted leg equipment, from Nothing through Netherite; empty selection skips the slot. Default Nothing.
Accepted foot equipment, from Nothing through Netherite; empty selection skips the slot. Default Nothing.
Check scoreboard-name length and the selected character validators.
Enable name validation. Default true.
Accepted UTF-16 name length. Default 3–16; allowed endpoints 1–32.
Every selected validator must accept the entire name. Empty selection disables character checks. Default Vanilla.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiBot.mode.matrix-: Detect duplicate profiles or property-free suspects with fully enchanted armor or an equipment-object change after one tick.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiBot.mode.intave-: Detect a suspect whose initial ping of at least 2 changes to zero within 15 ms. The first packet action controls handling.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiBot.mode.horizon: Detect added player-info entries whose game mode is absent.
Exactly one online profile has the same name and a different UUID.
Player info is missing or its game mode is null.
The entity is at least 20 ticks old and its ping is zero or negative.
Absolute player pitch exceeds 90 degrees.
The entity ID is outside 0 through 1,000,000,000.
No attack-entity event has targeted this entity.
The entity health exceeds the local player maximum health.
No swing-animation packet has been observed.
No critical or magic-critical animation packet has been observed.
No entity-attributes packet has been observed.
The computed scale attribute is not exactly 1.0.
Accept Nothing equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Leather equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Chain equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Iron equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Gold equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Diamond equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Netherite equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Elytra equipment where this choice is available.
Accept TurtleScute equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Pumpkin equipment where this choice is available.
Accept Skull equipment where this choice is available.
ASCII letters, digits and underscore.
Code points U+0400 through U+052F.
Code points U+4E00 through U+9FA5.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.description: Aim projectile weapons with motion prediction, release shots automatically, and optionally accelerate bow charging.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.autoShoot.de: Configure automatic release of bows, crossbows and tridents.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.autoShoot.en: Automatically shoot when charge, delay and aiming conditions are satisfied.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.autoShoot.ch: Ticks to draw a bow before releasing, with the cached random offset added.
Gaussian random offset added to bow charge time, refreshed after each automatic bow shot.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.autoShoot.de: Minimum elapsed seconds since the previous shot or since a bow stopped being used.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.autoShoot.ai: Maximum angle between server aim and the active managed rotation when the aimbot is enabled.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.autoShoot.re: Require the forty-tick projectile simulation to hit a valid target, instead of checking managed aim.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.autoShoot.us: Allow shooting an already loaded crossbow from either hand without holding use.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.bowAimbot.de: Calculate projectile aim using target motion, gravity, drag and visible points.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.bowAimbot.en: Aim while using a bow, crossbow or trident, or while holding a loaded crossbow.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.bowAimbot.th: Skip full-trajectory collision verification; the solver still needs a visible approach point near the target.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.bowAimbot.ta: Configure eligible targets and their ordered sorting criteria.
Maximum angular distance from the current view to the nearest part of a target hitbox.
Reject targets whose remaining damage immunity exceeds this many ticks.
Apply the selected criteria in order; later criteria resolve ties, and at least one is required.
Prefer players, then hostile mobs, then other entities.
Prefer lower health, using a recognized below-name health objective when available.
Prefer the target hitbox closest to the player eye.
Prefer the hitbox requiring the smallest change from the current view.
Prefer targets with less remaining damage immunity.
Prefer entities that have existed for more ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.fastCharge.d: Accelerate bow use by sending movement packets and updating the active item repeatedly.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.fastCharge.e: Enable accelerated charging while using a bow.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.fastCharge.s: Extra movement packets and item-use updates attempted each game tick.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.fastCharge.n: Only accelerate charging while the player is on the ground.
Only accelerate charging while the player has no movement input.
Suspend accelerated charging while the Regeneration effect is active.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoBow.fastCharge.p: Select the movement-packet fields sent for each accelerated charge update.
