englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.inventoryMove.behavi: Screen policy: Normal, Safe (block inventory clicks while moving), Undetectable (stop in containers), or StopOnAction (pause movement before sending container actions).
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.inventoryMove.passth: Read the physical sneak binding through supported screens. Text fields still suppress movement.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.inventoryMove.sprint: Override sprint while a container or the server-side player inventory is open.
Keep, force, or suppress client sprint. Forcing sprint requires directional movement.
Keep, force, or suppress server sprint. Applied after client control for the sprint key.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.inventoryMove.sneakC: Override sneak while a container or server-side player inventory is open.
Keep, force, or suppress the client sneak input.
Request the shared game timer while a container screen is open.
Game speed from 0.1 to 2.0, with InventoryMove timer priority.
Pass container actions and queue other outgoing packets in the shared Blink manager while a container screen is open.
Close the container after this many milliseconds and release the shared queue when other Blink users permit it.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.baseUrl: Provider API root; blank uses the selected protocol default.
Provider API key. This module is excluded from public AutoConfig exports.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.model.d: Model identifier sent to the configured provider.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.reactio: Random delay before sending an answer or automatic gg, in milliseconds.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.cooldow: Minutes to wait before accepting another chat game trigger.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.bufferT: Collect system messages for this many milliseconds after the trigger.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.trigger: Case-sensitive text that begins a chat game question.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.include: Include the trigger message in the question sent to the AI provider.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.serverN: Replace {SERVER_NAME} in the prompt with this server name.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoChatGame.answerT: Java format string applied when sending; %s is the answer. A leading slash sends a command.
System prompt sent with each question.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.description: Automatically cast and retrieve a fishing rod against selected combat targets.
Choose direct point tracking or a gravity-and-drag projectile solution.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.range.descri: Minimum and maximum player-to-target position distance for rod use.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.scanExtraRan: Random extension of the maximum range, sampled again after each successful cast.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.maxEnemiesNe: Maximum number of globally eligible targets; zero disables this limit.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.minHealth.de: Require the player health to be strictly greater than this value.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.minTargetHea: Require target health to be strictly greater than this value.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.requires.des: All selected requirements must hold before aiming or starting a new rod sequence.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.requires.cli: Require the physical attack binding to be held, or its mouse button to have been pressed within 250 ms.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.requires.mou: Require nonzero physical mouse turn input within the previous 100 ms.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.requires.wea: Require a sword, a modern-combat axe, a mace, or an item enchanted with Knockback in the main hand.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.requires.van: Require the main-hand item to have no custom name component.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.requires.not: Require the interaction manager not to be destroying a block.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.ignore.descr: Pause aiming and new rod sequences when any selected condition is true.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.ignore.openI: Pause when a container screen or server-side inventory is open.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.ignore.using: Pause while the player is actually using an item.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.ignore.holdi: Pause when either hand has the consumable component.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.holdingItems: Never start rod use while the main hand holds one of these registry items.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.aimOffThresh: Maximum angle between the server direction and the freshly calculated rod aim before casting.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.swingMode.de: Show the predicted interaction swing or hide it from the local client.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.hitTimeout.d: Maximum ticks to wait before retrieving the hook.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.pullOnOutOfR: Retrieve the rod if the captured target leaves the range selected for this cast.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.slotResetDel: Random ticks to retain the rod slot after pulling; offhand use does not select a hotbar slot.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.cooldown.des: Random ticks after pulling before another rod sequence can start.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.aimPoint.des: Project points onto the predicted target hitbox and process Delay, Lazy, then Gaussian offsets.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.aimPoint.exe: Remove selected thirds of the target hitbox from point candidates.
Exclude points around the nearest original hit vector using separate vertical and horizontal tolerances.
Enable exclusion around the nearest hit vector.
Vertical exclusion distance from the nearest hit vector.
Horizontal exclusion radius around the nearest hit vector.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.aimPoint.gau: Move a persistent random offset toward successive Gaussian targets.
Random horizontal multiplier for the Gaussian X and Z offsets.
Random vertical multiplier for the Gaussian Y offset.
Probability of choosing another Gaussian target once the previous one is close enough.
Independently sampled interpolation factor for each offset axis.
Per-axis distance treated as having reached the target offset.
Configure the entity-aware Gaussian helper; point-box processing retains the upstream non-entity path.
Enable entity-aware dynamic adjustment when a living-entity input is supplied.
Minimum input-entity hurt time for dynamic adjustment.
Add player horizontal speed multiplied by this factor to horizontal offset strength.
Add player horizontal speed multiplied by this factor to vertical offset strength.
Per-axis interpolation factor used by active dynamic adjustment.
Per-axis arrival tolerance used by active dynamic adjustment.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.aimPoint.laz: Retain a previous point until the sampled distance threshold is reached.
Sample a new minimum movement distance after a point is accepted.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.aimPoint.del: Delay adoption of changed point-box samples.
Enable point-delay processing before lazy and Gaussian processing.
Random number of changed samples before the stored point is replaced.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.target.descr: Configure eligible targets and their ordered sorting criteria.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.target.fov.d: Maximum angular distance from the current view to the nearest part of a target hitbox.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.target.hurtT: Reject targets whose remaining damage immunity exceeds this many ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.target.prior: Apply the selected criteria in order; later criteria resolve ties, and at least one is required.
Prefer players, then hostile mobs, then other entities.
Prefer lower health, using a recognized below-name health objective when available.
Prefer the target hitbox closest to the player eye.
Prefer the hitbox requiring the smallest change from the current view.
Prefer targets with less remaining damage immunity.
Prefer entities that have existed for more ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.rotations.de: Settings used to smoothly return the managed rotation after a server correction in ResetRotation mode.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.rotations.mo: Choose how movement follows the managed rotation: Off, Strict, Silent, or ChangeLook.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.rotations.re: Stop resetting once the managed rotation is within this many degrees of the visible rotation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.rotations.ti: Keep the requested rotation for this many ticks before beginning the reset.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoRod.rotations.an: Random horizontal turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random vertical turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random horizontal turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Random vertical turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Steepness of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Midpoint of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Random limit on the change in horizontal turn speed each tick.
Random limit on the change in vertical turn speed each tick.
Use target-entity crosshair acceleration when a target exists. NoRotateSet reset requests have no target entity.
Distance contribution to acceleration. NoRotateSet reset requests use a target distance of zero.
Horizontal acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Vertical acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Add a random error proportional to the turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in horizontal turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in vertical turn acceleration.
Add a random fixed-angle error to each turn step.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in horizontal turns.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in vertical turns.
Scale turn acceleration by a Sigmoid curve as the remaining angle changes.
Steepness of the acceleration deceleration curve.
Midpoint of the acceleration deceleration curve.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.description: Predict a void fall and rescue with GhostBlock, Flag, Blink or UseItem. Disabled by default.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.descri: Select the rescue mode. Default GhostBlock. All modes predict the first falling snapshot among ticks 0–9.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.voidLevel.d: Bottom Y coordinate of each collision column. Default 0; range -256–0.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.ghostB: Give empty collision shapes below the last safe position a full-block shape while a void fall is predicted.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.flag.d: Raise the player or the next movement event after the configured fall distance.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.flag.f: Minimum fall distance before Flag rescue. Default 0.5; range 0–6.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.flag.h: Y offset added during rescue. Default 0.42; range 0.01–10.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.flag.s: Apply Height to the next PRE movement event instead of moving the local body. Default false.
Queue outgoing packets while a void fall is predicted; cancel the shared Blink queue to return to its first position. Scaffold exempts this mode.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.antiVoid.mode.useIte: Use a configured item when falling fast and no ground is predicted in ticks 1–40.
Require vertical velocity below this threshold. Default -0.5; range -1.0–-0.1.
Random silent hotbar reset delay. Default 4–6; endpoints 0–40 ticks.
Accepted item registry entries. Default magma cream. Prefer the selected hand, then offhand, then the nearest hotbar slot.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.descriptio: Follow an incoming ender pearl by predicting its impact and throwing a pearl toward it.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.mode.descr: Trigger follows attackable owners or ownerless pearls; Target follows the actual KillAura target.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.mode.value: Follow pearls from attackable entities and pearls with no resolved owner.
Follow only pearls owned by the current KillAura target.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.rotate.des: Turn toward the solved throw rotation before throwing.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.rotate.ena: Wait up to twenty ticks until the server view is within one degree; abort on timeout.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.limits.des: Restrict pearl angle, activation distance and simulated destination error.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.limits.ena: Apply the angle and distance restrictions; both real trajectories still require an impact.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.limits.ang: Maximum angle from the crosshair to the incoming pearl bounding box.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.limits.min: Ignore an incoming pearl whose predicted impact is strictly nearer than this distance from your feet.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.limits.des: Your simulated impact must be strictly closer than this distance to the incoming pearl impact.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.combatPaus: Pause automatic combat for at least this many ticks while a throw waits in the queue.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.slotResetD: Random delay before releasing the silent hotbar selection used for the pearl.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.autoPearl.rotate.rot: Settings used to smoothly return the managed rotation after a server correction in ResetRotation mode.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.easyPearl.descriptio: Throw an ender pearl at the position you are looking at.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.easyPearl.aimOffThre: Throw once the server view differs from the solved direction by at most this angle.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.easyPearl.reachableC: Cancel a throw at an unreachable block and display the original warning.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.easyPearl.showDistan: Show the distance from your feet to the aimed position in the world.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.requires.desc: Require every selected condition; any open screen prevents preparing a new aim regardless of Ignore.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.requires.clic: Require the physical attack binding to be held, or its mouse button to have been pressed within 250 ms.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.requires.mous: Require nonzero physical mouse turn input within the previous 100 ms.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.requires.weap: Require a sword, a modern-combat axe, a mace, or an item enchanted with Knockback in the main hand.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.requires.vani: Require the main-hand item to have no custom name component.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.requires.notB: Require the interaction manager not to be destroying a block.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.aimPoint.desc: Choose a point on the current zero-tick target box, then apply persistent Delay, Lazy and Gaussian processors.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.aimPoint.exem: Remove selected thirds of the target hitbox from point candidates.
Exclude points around the nearest original hit vector using separate vertical and horizontal tolerances.
Enable exclusion around the nearest hit vector.
Vertical exclusion distance from the nearest hit vector.
Horizontal exclusion radius around the nearest hit vector.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.aimPoint.gaus: Move a persistent random offset toward successive Gaussian targets.
Random horizontal multiplier for the Gaussian X and Z offsets.
Random vertical multiplier for the Gaussian Y offset.
Probability of choosing another Gaussian target once the previous one is close enough.
Independently sampled interpolation factor for each offset axis.
Per-axis distance treated as having reached the target offset.
Configure the entity-aware Gaussian helper; point-box processing retains the upstream non-entity path.
Enable entity-aware dynamic adjustment when a living-entity input is supplied.
Minimum input-entity hurt time for dynamic adjustment.
Add player horizontal speed multiplied by this factor to horizontal offset strength.
Add player horizontal speed multiplied by this factor to vertical offset strength.
Per-axis interpolation factor used by active dynamic adjustment.
Per-axis arrival tolerance used by active dynamic adjustment.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.aimPoint.lazy: Retain a previous point until the sampled distance threshold is reached.
Sample a new minimum movement distance after a point is accepted.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.aimPoint.dela: Delay adoption of changed point-box samples.
Enable point-delay processing before lazy and Gaussian processing.
Random number of changed samples before the stored point is replaced.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.target.descri: Configure eligible targets and their ordered sorting criteria.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.target.fov.de: Maximum angular distance from the current view to the nearest part of a target hitbox.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.target.hurtTi: Reject targets whose remaining damage immunity exceeds this many ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.target.priori: Apply the selected criteria in order; later criteria resolve ties, and at least one is required.
Prefer players, then hostile mobs, then other entities.
Prefer lower health, using a recognized below-name health objective when available.
Prefer the target hitbox closest to the player eye.
Prefer the hitbox requiring the smallest change from the current view.
Prefer targets with less remaining damage immunity.
Prefer entities that have existed for more ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.description: Automatically face selected living targets or end crystals using mouse-aware interpolated rotation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.range.descrip: Maximum distance from the player eyes to the nearest target hitbox point.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.wallRange.des: Allowed hidden-hit distance; changing this value clamps it to the current Range.
Retain the current player direction when its entity ray already hits the chosen target within visibility limits.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.crystals.desc: Consider end crystals first, sorted by the smallest crosshair-to-hitbox angle.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.crystals.enab: Enable crystal candidates before the ordinary target list.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.crystals.only: Exclude living targets while crystal targeting is enabled, including when no crystal qualifies.
Include crystals only while the physical use-item binding is held.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.requires.empt: Require the actual main-hand item stack to be empty.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.d: Choose Interpolation, Sigmoid or Linear smoothing before render interpolation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.i: Combine Bezier and sigmoid factors with the previous RotationManager target direction change.
Random horizontal percentage for each new smooth rotation.
Random vertical percentage for each new smooth rotation.
Random extra factor for changes from the previous managed rotation target.
Normalized angle at which smoothing switches between sigmoid and Bezier factors.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.s: Limit component turn speeds using a sigmoid curve based on the remaining angle.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.l: Limit horizontal and vertical rotation components by the sampled turn speeds.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.axis.descript: Apply the selected axes; unselected axes retain the stored tick rotation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.ignore.descri: Allow the stored aim to continue rendering in selected open-screen conditions.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.ignore.screen: Continue rendering the stored aim while any screen is open.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.ignore.contai: Continue rendering the stored aim while a container screen or server inventory is open.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.l: Random horizontal turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random vertical turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.aimbot.angleSmooth.s: Random horizontal turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Random vertical turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.

Midpoint of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.

Vertical acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Add a random error proportional to the turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in horizontal turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in vertical turn acceleration.
Add a random fixed-angle error to each turn step.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in horizontal turns.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in vertical turns.
Scale turn acceleration by a Sigmoid curve as the remaining angle changes.
Steepness of the acceleration deceleration curve.
Midpoint of the acceleration deceleration curve.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fakeLag.description: Hold outgoing packets to avoid enemy hits, sharing the global Blink queue.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fakeLag.range.descri: Minimum and maximum target hitbox distance for nearby enemies; the maximum also bounds dynamic checks at the queued server position.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fakeLag.delay.descri: Random hold limit in milliseconds, sampled initially and again when the oldest queued packet reaches the limit.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fakeLag.recoilTime.d: Milliseconds after a selected flush interaction before queuing is allowed again.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fakeLag.mode.descrip: Constant always queues eligible packets; Dynamic keeps lag only with nearby enemies when the queued position is at least as safe as the client position.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.fakeLag.flushOn.desc: Interactions that stop FakeLag queuing and reset its recoil timer. Other modules can still keep the shared queue held.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitFX.description: Adds hit particles and original replacement sounds after a vanilla hit sound confirms a living last target within four blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitFX.particle.descr: Randomly selects one of the enabled particle effects per emitter. Empty selection disables particles. Default Fire.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitFX.particleAmount: Inclusive number of tracking emitters per confirmed hit, 1 to 20. Blood uses redstone block destruction effects.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitFX.otherSound.des: Random sound group and variant replacing a recognized hit sound within four blocks of the last living target. Empty retains vanilla. Default Pop.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.hitFX.selfSound.desc: Replaces the local player damage-event hurt sound. Empty retains vanilla. Default Boykisser.

englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.des: Track Eye of Ender throws and estimate stronghold chunks using a Bayesian posterior.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.hyp: Number of deterministic stronghold layouts evaluated for each posterior.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.req: Require every throw in one hypothesis to target the same stronghold.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.sam: Wait this many player ticks before sampling a spawned eye.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.min: Wait until the eye reaches this minimum horizontal speed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.max: Maximum age of a pending throw when matching its spawned eye.
Maximum horizontal distance between a throw and its spawned eye.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.sho: Number of highest probability candidate chunks to retain and render.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.ren: Draw a 2048 block direction ray for each recorded measurement.
Highlight the most likely stronghold chunk.
Highlight additional high probability candidate chunks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.ann: Notify when the best predicted chunk changes.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.strongholdFinder.res: Clear samples, predictions and portal highlights when the world changes.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.requires.de: Require every selected condition before preparing or executing combat actions.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.requires.cl: Require the physical attack binding to be held, or its mouse button to have been pressed within 250 ms.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.requires.mo: Require nonzero physical mouse turn input within the previous 100 ms.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.requires.we: Require a sword, a modern-combat axe, a mace, or an item enchanted with Knockback in the main hand.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.requires.va: Require the main-hand item to have no custom name component.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.requires.no: Require the interaction manager not to be destroying a block.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.aimPoint.de: Project points onto the predicted target hitbox and process Delay, Lazy, then Gaussian offsets.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.aimPoint.ex: Remove selected thirds of the target hitbox from point candidates.
Exclude points around the nearest original hit vector using separate vertical and horizontal tolerances.
Enable exclusion around the nearest hit vector.
Vertical exclusion distance from the nearest hit vector.
Horizontal exclusion radius around the nearest hit vector.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.aimPoint.ga: Move a persistent random offset toward successive Gaussian targets.
Random horizontal multiplier for the Gaussian X and Z offsets.
Random vertical multiplier for the Gaussian Y offset.
Probability of choosing another Gaussian target once the previous one is close enough.
Independently sampled interpolation factor for each offset axis.
Per-axis distance treated as having reached the target offset.
Configure the entity-aware Gaussian helper; point-box processing retains the upstream non-entity path.
Enable entity-aware dynamic adjustment when a living-entity input is supplied.
Minimum input-entity hurt time for dynamic adjustment.
Add player horizontal speed multiplied by this factor to horizontal offset strength.
Add player horizontal speed multiplied by this factor to vertical offset strength.
Per-axis interpolation factor used by active dynamic adjustment.
Per-axis arrival tolerance used by active dynamic adjustment.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.aimPoint.la: Retain a previous point until the sampled distance threshold is reached.
Sample a new minimum movement distance after a point is accepted.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.aimPoint.de: Delay adoption of changed point-box samples.
Enable point-delay processing before lazy and Gaussian processing.
Random number of changed samples before the stored point is replaced.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.target.desc: Configure eligible targets and their ordered sorting criteria.
Maximum angular distance from the current view to the nearest part of a target hitbox.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.target.hurt: Reject targets whose remaining damage immunity exceeds this many ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.target.prio: Apply the selected criteria in order; later criteria resolve ties, and at least one is required.
Prefer players, then hostile mobs, then other entities.
Prefer lower health, using a recognized below-name health objective when available.
Prefer the target hitbox closest to the player eye.
Prefer the hitbox requiring the smallest change from the current view.
Prefer targets with less remaining damage immunity.
Prefer entities that have existed for more ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.description: Automatically aim and attack eligible enemies using the configured click schedule.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.clicker.des: Independent attack click plan shared with other attack clickers and physical presses.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.clicker.ite: Require the sampled attack cooldown unless an enabled exception applies.
Random minimum attack cooldown progress; 1.0 means a fully charged attack.
Bypass cooldown when the target would block and AutoWeapon predicts a shield break.
Bypass cooldown when AutoWeapon predicts a mace smash.
Bypass cooldown when the predicted player and target positions will leave attack range.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.range.descr: Configure visible, obstructed and target-scanning distances.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.range.range: Add this value to the actual entity interaction attribute and held-item attack range.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.range.throu: Maximum distance for obstructed hits, clamped to the current interaction range when changed.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.range.scanR: Random extension of target scan range, sampled again after attacks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.target.igno: Allow selecting targets even when their shield would block this hit.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.raycast.des: Choose whether the attack ray keeps its target, selects another enemy, or can select any hit entity.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.criticals.d: Choose smart critical timing, always require a critical, or ignore critical timing.
Keep sprinting when the attack path permits it.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.ignoreOpenI: Continue combat while a container or server inventory is open.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.simulateInv: Send inventory-close preparation around attacks when inventory restrictions are ignored.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.r: Normal prepares continuously; Snap rotates for the attack; OnTick prepares on click ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.t: Allow preparing a rotation towards targets hidden by blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.l: Keep the current direction when its ray can still hit the selected target.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.autoBlockin: Use a blocking item between attacks with the selected release and reblock timing.
Basic uses the blocking item; Interact first interacts with the target; Fake only shows a blocking pose.
Try hands in the same order as vanilla item use.
Release by stopping use, changing slots, swapping hands, or keeping the current use.
Random number of ticks between releasing and starting to block again.
Random ticks to pause attacks after releasing a blocking item.
Chance to start a new block action.
Hold movement packets while blocking for up to this many ticks.
Delay attacks while blocking has priority.
Allow blocking while a target is within scan range but outside attack range.
Block only when the target threatens the player or is within the forced range.
Expand the target attack check by this distance.
Always treat a target inside this configured distance interval as dangerous.
Compatibility option for older item protocols without a blocks-attacks component.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.failSwing.d: Swing when a target is nearby but the real attack ray does not hit it.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.failSwing.a: Random extra distance within which missed-target swings may occur.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.failSwing.n: Show no feedback, a small fading box, or a sound for missed swings.
Mark missed hit points with fading boxes.
Lifetime of missed-hit boxes in seconds.
Animate missed-hit box colors through the rainbow.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.de: Navigate independently towards combat positions or a named leader.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.en: Enable combat movement and its independent navigator.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.re: Draw the independently calculated combat route and navigation actions.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.op: Distance used to decide whether the opponent is close enough to threaten the player.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.da: Avoid positions inside this angular sector around the opponent facing direction.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.ru: Move away when an opponent is close and the clicker is not ready to attack.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.ta: Additional target selection rules while FightBot is running.
Maximum boxed distance for FightBot target selection.
Select only entities with a real line of sight from the player.
Require a real block collision below the target box down to Y=-64.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.le: Give a matching named player priority over combat movement goals.
Exact profile name of the player to follow.
Desired distance from the leader and threshold for the movement jump assist.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rangeIndica: Draw the active attack ranges around the player.
Enable attack-range rendering.
Choose static colors, a rainbow, or colors interpolated by target distance.
Color while no attack target is selected.
Color while an attack target is selected.
Draw an outline around the range surface.
ARGB color of the range outline.
Animate the range radius with a pulse.
Speed of the radius pulse animation.
Strength of the range radius pulse.
Fade the range indicator as its active state changes.
Interpolation speed of the indicator fade.
ARGB color of the through-walls distance ring; zero alpha hides it.
ARGB color of the target scan distance ring; zero alpha hides it.
ARGB color of the three-block opponent reference ring; zero alpha hides it.
Hide the indicator when the player is dead.
Hide the indicator in spectator mode.
Hide the indicator while the player is a passenger.
Apply KillAura inventory restrictions to indicator visibility.
Allow world geometry to occlude the range indicator.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.al: Allow breaking blocks along the route.
Allow placing suitable hotbar blocks along the route.
Search and follow jump routes across gaps.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.ri: Allow jumps with less landing margin.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.ma: Largest permitted dry fall, additionally limited by player health.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.pa: Maximum distance considered in each route search. Default 64 blocks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.al: Use creative flight when player abilities permit it.
Use an equipped elytra to glide along the route.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.el: Use available fireworks to propel elytra flight.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.al: Use a boat when travelling across water.
Eat available food along the route when hungry.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.fightBot.re: Show the searched route, progress and destination.
Let world geometry hide route graphics.
Color of the route search preview.
Color of blocks scheduled to be broken.
Color of blocks scheduled to be placed.
Color of route targets and engaged ghost graphics.
Color of a route invalidated by the world or server.
Show a server position ghost when the navigation view supplies one.
Milliseconds before completed or invalid routes disappear. Default 800.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.d: Aim using the full combat rotation processor chain.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.m: Choose how movement follows the managed rotation: Off, Strict, Silent, or ChangeLook.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.r: Stop resetting once the managed rotation is within this many degrees of the visible rotation.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.t: Keep the requested rotation for this many ticks before beginning the reset.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.a: Random horizontal turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random vertical turn limit in degrees per tick for Linear smoothing.
Random horizontal turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Random vertical turn limit before Sigmoid smoothing is applied.
Steepness of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Midpoint of the Sigmoid turn-speed curve.
Random limit on the change in horizontal turn speed each tick.
Random limit on the change in vertical turn speed each tick.
Use target-entity crosshair acceleration when a target exists. NoRotateSet reset requests have no target entity.
Distance contribution to acceleration. NoRotateSet reset requests use a target distance of zero.
Horizontal acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Vertical acceleration used when the crosshair is on a target entity; reset requests without an entity do not use it.
Add a random error proportional to the turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in horizontal turn acceleration.
Maximum random proportional error in vertical turn acceleration.
Add a random fixed-angle error to each turn step.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in horizontal turns.
Maximum random fixed-angle error in vertical turns.
Scale turn acceleration by a Sigmoid curve as the remaining angle changes.
Steepness of the acceleration deceleration curve.
Midpoint of the acceleration deceleration curve.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.clicker.tec: Human varies the click rhythm; Constant uses the upper CPS endpoint. Default Human.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.clicker.cPS: Clicks per second, sampled by the selected technique. Default 11–14.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.clicker.max: Limit scheduled clicks in one game tick. Default 2.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.clicker.mis: Wait for the real miss timer before attacking. Default true; this clicker has no item-cooldown setting.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.a: Choose Linear, Sigmoid, Interpolation, Acceleration or AI. Default Linear.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.s: Temporarily limit rotation to a tiny movement.
Chance of starting a stop during each processed rotation. Default 3 percent.
Number of processed rotations to stop. Default 1–2 ticks.
englishDescriptions.liquidbounce.module.killAura.rotations.f: Occasionally offset aim using previous and server rotations.
Enable deliberate aim failures. Default false.
Chance per game tick of starting a failure. Default 3 percent.
Scale the previous-to-server rotation difference. Default 0.04.
Random horizontal aim shift. Default 5–10 degrees.
Random vertical aim shift. Default 0–2 degrees.
Keep the sampled failure for this many ticks. Default 1–4.

Select the original built-in regression model. Default 21KC11KP.
Correction after model output: Interpolation, Linear or None. Retained while AI falls back.
Horizontal model-correction speed. Default 5 degrees.
Vertical model-correction speed. Default 5 degrees.
Scale the two model outputs before correction.
Model horizontal-output multiplier. Default 1.5.
Model vertical-output multiplier. Default 1.
Interpolate toward the target using angle and direction change.
Horizontal interpolation speed. Default 80–85 percent.
Vertical interpolation speed. Default 20–25 percent.
Additional factor for changing target direction. Default 95–100 percent.
Threshold between sigmoid and Bezier interpolation. Default 0.35.
Interpolate toward the target using angle and direction change.
Horizontal interpolation speed. Default 2–5 percent.
Vertical interpolation speed. Default 2–5 percent.
Additional factor for changing target direction. Default 95–100 percent.
Threshold between sigmoid and Bezier interpolation. Default 0.35.
